candidate.summary: Seeking full-time roles, PhD positions or CIFRE opportunities in China and Europe. Research and industry tracks are evaluated separately. Internships only at explicitly allowlisted employers.

dimensions.label: 方向匹配
dimensions.guide: Compare the concrete duties or research topic to documented candidate facts. Do not infer mathematics or product experience from AI experience alone.

dimensions.label: 经历证据
dimensions.guide: Require specific verified projects or research. Interests and planned publications are not completed experience.

dimensions.label: 经验与资格
dimensions.guide: Distinguish internship experience from full-time employment. Record unknown enrolment, work authorization, degree and start-date requirements as gaps.

dimensions.label: 工作语言
dimensions.guide: Use confirmed language abilities and explicit requirements. A French JD alone does not require a French resume.

dimensions.label: 发展方向
dimensions.guide: For a PhD/CIFRE assess research question, supervision and funding evidence; for industry assess duties and team. Unknown details are gaps.
